name: dark-factory
description: The autonomous implementer loop — a ranked task queue, adversarial verification, a release ritual — behind hook-enforced guard rails: single-writer lane guard, fail-closed commit gate, no-push wall, stop-gate exit ritual. Tri-harness: one plugin directory serves Claude Code (.claude-plugin/plugin.json — which ZCode also probes), Kimi Code (this manifest), and ZCode; all read the same .dark-factory/ state, so the harnesses can run on the same repo.
